missions.purpose: To gain first-hand experience with programming and gather enough information to choose the next learning step.
missions.description: Set aside 30–45 minutes and complete one beginner Python lesson or exercise in an online environment that runs in the browser. The exercise should include writing or modifying a short program, such as displaying text, using variables, or making a simple calculation. Afterwards, record what felt easy, difficult, and interesting, and note whether you would prefer more lessons like this or a different kind of introduction.

The individual has noted one aspect they enjoyed, one difficulty, and one preference for the next step.
A decision has been made about whether to continue with Python, try another format, or explore a different programming goal.
